evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, preflight validates only that prior_sha is a full SHA (675-676) and then runs the queue-compatibility gate shown at 713-718, whose rejection text concerns the live queue disabling automatic rollback, not the helper's verify_target ancestry. The supplied pre-switch flow through 758 contains no ancestry check on prior_sha, even though prior_sha is the rollback target. A clean local/unmerged HEAD therefore passes preflight and the forward switch, while the later rollback switch's verify_target fails, leaving admission held and recovery required. That is a correctness defect in the intended rollback fallback, not a new requirement; the smallest fix is to apply the same ancestry rule to the prior SHA before admission and any switch.
